message.content: This editorial illustration features the title "TEMPO" in large red letters at the top, above an illustration of three men. A man with distinctive orange hair and a grey face stands with his back turned, right hand raised in a waving gesture. He wears a dark suit. In the foreground, two other men in dark suits sit at a round white table. The man on the left is in profile, looking at a document held in both hands. The man on the right holds a paper and scratches his head with his left hand, appearing distressed. On the table are several stacks of white paper, two black notebooks with orange edges, and two black pens. The background is a dark, textured grey. Transcribed text includes: "Gonjang-ganjing Beasiswa LPDP H.26", "Jaringan Narkotik Kapolres Bima H.76", "DEMI TRUMP, UNTUK TRUMP", and a paragraph beginning "Juru runding pemerintah kewalahan...". The top right contains a barcode, QR code, and publication details like "2-8 MARET 2026" and "RP 60.000". Small red text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears below the main title.
